detail.activity_name: Winter Break Inclusion Support Pre-Enrollment Application
detail.online_notes:
The Day Camp Accessibility and Inclusion program provides 1:1 support for children ages 4-12 years old who require additional assistance in order to participate in camp programming. It is important to note that enrolling in this course, your child is not yet registered for camp.

This enrollment puts your child’s name on a list in sequential order. You will then be contacted by a Day Camp staff who will review the camp location/week/program options with you and ask more detailed information about your child’s need to ensure this program is the right fit and that we are setting them up for a successful Winter Break. After placement has been confirmed, your child's information will be sent to our Contact Centre and you will be contacted to finalize the registration. There is no additional cost to be enrolled in this program.

Please note, YMCA Inclusions counsellors do not provide assistance with medical equipment or procedures such as g-tube feeding or catheter care and do not provide any washroom assistance which includes; lifts, wiping and diaper changes.

If your child requires specialized 1:1 support that the YMCA does not provide, you are welcome to provide your own Personal Support Worker. The PSW will need to provide a police check and complete a brief YMCA training. Email inclusion.daycamp@ymcagta.org to ensure the PSW is approved and set up correctly to attend camp.
